text: This is the song I got for my Friday morning run.
When I started, it was just this. One low note.
Every few minutes outside, my phone added a layer. Pads.
Then bass. The composer is Gemma, an open model running on my phone.
Drums. No server. My location never left my pocket.
And at the end, ten seconds of the street I ran down.
Thirty-five minutes outside. Three point four kilometers. Every layer.
Every day gets its own song. Friday's was Ephemeral Echoes.
